span.p:
Read ICR1 (Timer1 input capture register)
Read ovf_count (overflows since last capture)
Race fix: if TOV1 flag set and capture < 0x8000, add 1 to ovf
Reset ovf_count = 0

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
period_ticks = ovf × 65536 + (capture − prev_capture)
prev_capture = capture
(signed subtraction handles 16-bit wrap correctly)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
rpm = 120 000 000 / period_ticks
(= 60 s × 2 000 000 ticks/s ÷ period)
rpm clamped to 20 000 max
